title: backlog check's stale-touches error fires on the item that deleted the file, which done requires to name it
goal: backlog.py check does not report a stale touch on an open item whose own KB-Work commits deleted that path (the item that removes a file must name it, or done refuses the deletion as outside its scope), and still reports the path on any other open item; a planted test in _tools/test_backlog.py covers both

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import backlog as b;bl=b.Backlog('.');bl.items['TK-mose67gs']=dict(id='TK-mose67gs',kind='task',title='Delete test_querylog',status='doing',touches=['_tools/test_querylog.py']);e=[x for x in b.stale_touches(bl) if 'TK-mose67gs' in x];assert not e,'the item that deleted the file is reported: '+e[0][:160]
